stages.title: Static readiness
stages.criterion_scope: canonical Fort code pin; nuDSMC Linux/Mathematica readiness; no solver execution
stages.tolerance_basis: To be frozen after a declared pilot/calibration and upstream reference inspection, before confirmatory comparison.

stages.title: SM neutrino baseline
stages.required_inputs: same cosmology, initial state, electron/QED treatment and constants
stages.criterion_scope: compare rho_nu, Neff and energy balance; moments vs full spectra not forced equal
stages.tolerance_basis: To be frozen after a declared pilot/calibration and upstream reference inspection, before confirmatory comparison.

stages.title: Weak-rate interchange
stages.required_inputs: fixed f_nue,f_antinue and electron distributions with common correction scheme
stages.criterion_scope: compare n↔p integrals independently of background evolution
stages.tolerance_basis: To be frozen after a declared pilot/calibration and upstream reference inspection, before confirmatory comparison.

stages.title: Common X injection
stages.required_inputs: one symmetric small injection with identical forward/inverse processes
stages.criterion_scope: Fort X extension must first be sourced/implemented; no current plug-and-play claim
stages.tolerance_basis: To be frozen after a declared pilot/calibration and upstream reference inspection, before confirmatory comparison.

stages.title: Nonthermal convergence
stages.required_inputs: momentum grids/tails, time tolerances, seeds and MC statistics
stages.criterion_scope: full-QKE vs DSMC in their common physical regime; nudec is closure diagnostic
stages.tolerance_basis: To be frozen after a declared pilot/calibration and upstream reference inspection, before confirmatory comparison.

stages.title: BBN receiver comparison
stages.required_inputs: For deterministic comparison: common fixed rates/network/units/interpolation/reverse mapping, constants, initial conditions and compatible weak/background treatment. Joint uncertainty law only for UQ variant.
stages.criterion_scope: PRIMAT/LINX first; PRyM optional; shared nuclear data are common systematics
stages.tolerance_basis: To be frozen after a declared pilot/calibration and upstream reference inspection, before confirmatory comparison.

stages.title: Tensor transfer control
stages.required_inputs: known primordial spectrum and declared collision/perturbation model
stages.criterion_scope: coupled/free-streaming limits; no inference from background f alone
stages.tolerance_basis: To be frozen after a declared pilot/calibration and upstream reference inspection, before confirmatory comparison.

stages.title: Observational application
stages.required_inputs: one defined X, official likelihoods and overlap graph
stages.criterion_scope: BBN data once; ORCA analyses not blindly multiplied; ARCA interpretation is not second event
stages.tolerance_basis: To be frozen after a declared pilot/calibration and upstream reference inspection, before confirmatory comparison.

executor_selection_note: GitHub/Copilot route already chosen by owner; concrete runnable environment for this new package remains unverified. No automatic move to VM or arbitrary command bridge.

historical_s3_note: S3_STANDARD/eta baseline already saved at the pinned historical source. This extension does not mark it unperformed. S3 in neighbor prose is not V3 (common X injection). Missing covariance blocks a claimed physical fit, not every native calculation.
stage_order_note: V0–V7 are capability checks, not one mandatory serial chain. Native baselines can proceed without a new posterior. Deterministic common thermal BBN does not require X injection or full nonequilibrium QKE; declare its actual common subset.
